eligibility.evidence: Whole paper (Abstract, Methodology, Experiments, Results): a new 65k-question movie-based QA benchmark whose questions are generated from an LLM-built Social-Causal Graph. It labels the content Theory of Mind but cites no human paradigm the tasks derive from and names no classic paradigm (false-belief tasks appear only as prior work in the Introduction). Fails the E2 operational test; a reviewer could count 'ToM' as the domain and include it.

A.title: MovieGraph-ToM: Evaluating Long-Range Theory of Mind in Large Language Models via Implicit Social-Causal Graphs

G.notes: Excluded as benchmark-only. The converted text has no appendix (cited for model list, metric definitions, human evaluation), so model details could not be checked. Ten models tested; no human comparison; code link given in the abstract.
sections_read: Methodology (construction pipeline, graph and question statistics)
